# Janet

## Overview

- **Age:** forty  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P51](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0051)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Janet is tall, though not overly so, with a stoutish figure that maintains a restraint of outline. She features a sunny face with rosy cheeks, large and kind blue eyes resembling forget-me-nots, and soft, crimpy brown hair styled in a knot that contains a thread of gray.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)_

## Personality

Janet is known for her forgiving nature. She also demonstrates a sense of economy in her choices.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Last P50](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0050)_

## History

Janet Sweet lived at 'Wayside' in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where she spent twenty years receiving visits from her quiet admirer, [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who had never proposed to her. After being encouraged by her boarder, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), to take a stand, Janet sharply rejected John's offer to walk her home from a prayer meeting, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly intervened to reconcile the two. Following the death of John's mother, John proposed to Janet, revealing that his mother had bound him to a promise not to marry or tell anyone until after her death.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009), [v3 ch.Coming” P4](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0004), [v3 ch.Coming” P17](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0017), +6 more_

## Quotes

> "If she wasn’t—but she is. So we mustn’t speak evil of her. But I’m happy at last, Anne. And I wouldn’t have minded waiting so long a bit if I’d only known why."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Last P47](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0047)

> "Oh, she does. She’s told me time and again that she’d love to see John settled before her time comes. She’s always giving him hints—you heard her yourself the other day. I thought I’d ha’ gone through the floor."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010)

> “I couldn’t,” said poor Janet pathetically. “You see, Anne, I’ve always been awful fond of John. He might just as well keep coming as not, for there was never anybody else I’d want, so it didn’t matter.”
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)

> "No, I guess not. I was afraid to try, anyway, for fear he’d think I meant it and just go. I suppose I’m a poor-spirited creature, but that is how I feel. And I can’t help it."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P16](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0016)

> “I dunno,” said Janet hopelessly. “I dunno if I could ever get up enough spunk. Things have drifted so long. But I’ll think it over.”
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P18](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0018)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--janet.md)

Janet and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a warm friendship as housemate confidantes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays at 'Wayside' in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road). Janet confides her long-standing romantic frustrations to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who offers advice and later laughs with Janet over an awkward marriage proposal [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) received from the hired boy. When Anne's impulsive intervention temporarily damages Janet's romance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) takes action to reconcile the couple, and Janet later shares the joy of her engagement with her.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), [v3 ch.Philippa P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), +12 more_

- Friend of — confidantes who share stories and conversation  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), [v3 ch.Last P24](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0024), [v3 ch.Last P47](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0047)</sub>

### [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/janet--john-douglas.md)

Janet and [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) maintain a quiet, twenty-year courtship burdened by long-standing tension due to John's inability to propose. Although John visits Janet faithfully for two decades, his domineering mother forces him to promise not to marry or reveal the truth until after her death, leading to a temporary rupture when a frustrated Janet rejects his escort after a prayer meeting. Following his mother's death, John finally proposes to Janet and explains his secret oath, resolving their long wait.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008), +10 more_

- Romantically involved with — courting  <sub>[v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036)</sub>
